verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects' own API documentation gives worked examples for querying items, adding issues or draft issues, and updating fields with a token, so a documented API reference with examples exists. However, nothing shows an interactive explorer or in-browser runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, in-browser runnable or try-it examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can query the API to find information about items in your project.
